messages:
sasha: Quick status — starting cross-team sync for the throughput slate. Goal: land the KV warmup handshake + kernel microbatch changes this sprint. TL;DR: need two reviewers for runtime PRs and one owner for canary ops.

marc: I can review the kernel microbatch PR (#7892). What's the current perf delta on p50/p99?

sasha: Local sim numbers: p50 -3.4ms, p99 -12ms on short seq (32). End-to-end with KV warmup combined: p50 -8ms, p99 -25ms. Still seeing tail at 99.9 for long seqs. Perf doc: https://redwood.internal/perf/handshake-2026 :eyes: 

kai: Can you drop PR links? Also who actually owns the warmup config merge + canary rollout?

sasha: PRs — runtime/kernel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7892 (microbatch) ; runtime/kv: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7901 (kv-warmup). Owners: kernel review -> @marc, kv merge + runbook -> @tina, canary ops -> @kai.

tina: I can take the kv merge and write the canary playbook. Will add smoke checks and rollout buckets. Can we standardize batch_window_ms options to 5/8/12? Current test harness snippet: 
```
batch_window_ms: 8
kv_warmup: true
prefetch_shards: 3
```

marc: I'll review #7892 this afternoon. Quick question: is the kernel change backward-compatible with older quantized kernels? If not, we need a fallback policy documented.

sasha: Kernel exposes an opt-in path for quantized backends; fallback policy is in the router PR (#7904). I'll add notes in both PRs and include a small test harness to replay prefix cache sequences.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary environment 'slate-canary' has 16 GPUs free — you can start staged rollout once PRs are merged.

kai: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate canary windows. Proposed plan: baseline 10% for 2h -> 25% for 4h -> 100% ramp if no regressions. Need perf dashboard link + alert thresholds.

sasha: Dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/handshake-ops. Alert thresholds: p50 +10ms, p99 +25ms, error rate +0.2%. I'll author the explicit playbook in the runbook PR.

tina: Creating runbook PR now and will tag @oncall for the first window. ETA ~1.5h.

marc: :eyes: left review comments on #7892 — one nit on microkernel enum naming. Otherwise LGTM pending CI/test-run.

sasha: Owners summary: kernel review @marc, kv merge + runbook @tina, canary ops @kai. If no objections I'll update the sprint board and unblock QA. Thanks all :rocket:
